learning: The source-backed selection principle is a Powerhouse-wide outbound rule, not an Instagram-only rule.
guardrail: Shared evidence spine, channel-native transformation. Public evidence may select a personal topic but can never fabricate Arthur first-person experience.
root_cause: The evidence-first selection and learning principle existed in separate channel-specific implementations. Instagram/Mira, company content, personal content, email and LinkedIn DM did not share one enforced source-to-outcome lineage, so static fallbacks or untraceable outreach could still be selected.
prevention: Materialize source-backed candidates before channel selection and rank them ahead of static calendar or evergreen fallbacks.
Keep LinkedIn personal first-person claims bound to verified Arthur truth; external complaints may only supply theme evidence.
Require traceable account/person evidence before email or LinkedIn DM can remain send-eligible.
Preserve source/action/recommendation identifiers through provider readback and outcome learning.
Refresh the universal outbound lineage hourly so engagement, replies, leads, orders and revenue feed the next selection.

production_candidates.linkedin_personal: verified Arthur source + public theme inspiration only
